notes.title: 9/20 OFFICIAL RELEASE DATE!
notes.content:
[h2]ANNOUNCING THE FIRST RELEASE ON SEPTEMBER 9/20![/h2]

After a couple delays due to computers breaking down and having to rebuild everything on a new one, I finally have a build up for everyone to test out!

I will need your feedback, everything counts. I wanted to re-create an arcade feeling, so hopefully it'll at least a fun way to pass the time. Thank you for patience!
